messages.subject: Customer renewal at risk after repeated outages of your checkout during September
messages.text:
Hello Ana,

Our renewal of the Acme checkout contract is at risk after repeated outages of your checkout during September. Card payments from our web shop timed out on 29 September and again on 30 September, and our customers abandoned their orders.

Before we can renew we need a written incident review and a remediation plan. Please send them to ops@globex.example by Friday.

Regards,
Globex Operations

-- 
Globex Corporation - Operations
1 Example Way, Springfield

messages.subject: Re: Customer renewal at risk after repeated outages of your checkout during September
messages.text:
Hello,

We are sorry for the disruption. We traced the checkout timeouts to the dependency upgrade to httpclient 4.2, which changed the default connection pool size; we rolled back to httpclient 4.1 on 29 September and checkout has been stable since. You will have the incident review and the remediation plan by Friday.

Ana Lima
Acme

messages.subject: [acme/checkout] httpclient 4.2 introduced a timeout regression in checkout (Issue #482)
messages.text:
Since the dependency upgrade to httpclient 4.2, checkout calls to the payment gateway time out after 30 s.
The deployment of checkout on 2026-09-29 failed because of it and was rolled back.

Steps: deploy checkout with httpclient 4.2 and send a payment request.

—
Reply to this email directly, view it on GitHub:
https://github.com/acme/checkout/issues/482
You are receiving this because you were assigned.
